correctness.rationale: Ordered pair-collision de Bruijn graph has 12 off-diagonal states. Sharing a two-bit pair propagates backwards by Rule 30 left-permutivity and would force the two inputs equal. Exact finite 12-state graph enumeration isolates 8 vertices on closed walks, paired under predecessor swapping. The four-state quotient has seven labeled signed edges with orientation-flip bits; an ordered closed lift exists iff the total flip parity is even. Each excursion from A returns with output 11 0^m b and flip parity 1_{b=0}; the C zero loop gives only 0^n. This is all-length finite automaton proof, not inference from checking n<=16.
residual_risks: Finite checkers independently corroborate finite cases only; the explicit proof, not the log, bears the unrestricted claim.
